chapter: Records, dances and Blanche Calloway (repeated passages)
title: Blanche Calloway fronting the band and who played in it
summary: Blanche Calloway fronted the band for theatres and dances but did not write the arrangements; he lists members such as Clarence Smith, Abie Baker, Slim Moore and Stump Brady.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Take a band like the Blanche Calloway band. Was that mostly a show band, or did they play a lot for dancing, too?
We played for dances, too. We played theatres and dances.
Did she front the band as well as sing?
Yes.
She had a baton?
Yes. She looked good in front of a band.
Was she the real leader, or was there a musical director of some kind?
Was she what?
Was the leader actually...?
What do you mean?
I mean, did she select the music and stuff like that?

Did she write any of the things? No, she didn't write none of the things. I guess she did a few...a couple of things. I don't know whether she did the (?)... Because I didn't start with the band. I came in the band when the band had been together for a while. So I don't know who... She had some guys in there that were real good.
Dickenson - 113
I guess Edgar Battle had been in that band somewhere along the line.

Yeah, he had been in there. Then he got with a show called Puddinhead Jones or something like that. And they had a guy that played trumpet named Smitty, well-known... I mean, he was known around. Great first trumpet player. Clarence Smith.
What was his first name?
Clarence. And he was a great first trumpet player, you know. I just don't remember all the guys that was in that band offhand.
Abie Baker; he's still around.
Yeah. Abie Baker, and his brother, Earl. Jesus, I can't remember all the guys.
Slim Moore?
Yeah, Slim Moore. The other trombone player was Floyd Brady.
Stumpy.
Yeah, Stumpy.
You worked with him in some other bands.
Yeah, I worked with him and Floyd, too -- Claude Hopkins.
Yeah, he's still around.
Dickenson - 114
Yeah, I know. Too bad he don't play any more. Or does he? I don't know. You'd better shut that off now...
[PAUSE]
